description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git rebase functionality, focusing on rebase fast-forward behavior under various scenarios. It includes setup commands, test case definitions, and execution logic for automated testing of Git rebase operations.

methods.name: test_rebase_same_head
methods.description: A helper function that tests rebase operations when the current head is the same, verifying the state before and after rebase, and comparing expected outcomes based on parameters.

methods.name: test_rebase_same_head_
methods.description: Internal function that performs the individual rebase test, checking commit status, reflogs, and verifying whether the rebase resulted in expected commit states.
